Plan: P11.3b detector + tiered proposer + auto-coalesce.

Slice 1 (this session): detector workflow + intent board read + tiered rule-split proposer.
1. Survey post-P11.3a state: coalition.rs intent board (status:intent 30031), P11.1 ingress wiring (who owns subscriber), P11.2 soft-conflict freeze hook.
2. flywheel/src/intent.rs NEW: intent board read + tiered proposer rules (split by dir boundary / bead-dep; sequence by dep; merge same bead) + source-vs-doc path classifier (ignore README/config/docs).
3. Detector as authored workflow YAML (reaction on reservation_acquired status:intent).
4. Auto-coalesce hook: overlap on non-trivial source between unaffiliated crews -> auto-form ad-hoc coalition + propose split.
5. Wire into soft-conflict freeze path (P11.2) -> detector proposes instead of manual-only.
6. Gate: two crews declare overlapping intents on source dir -> detector fires -> rule-split proposed; README overlap does NOT coalesce.

Locks: flywheel/src/{intent,main,coalition,state,pane}.rs. Files edit in ~/workspace/flywheel.
